# Sarvartha Siddhi Yoga windows published by the reference almanac for Mumbai, 2025.
# Transcribed 2026-08-09 from the reference almanac's
#   Sarvartha Siddhi Yoga date/time page (?date=DD/MM/YYYY)
# (one month per page; the date parameter selects it; geoname-id selects the city).
# Format: M/D|Weekday|start|end. Times are local, the almanac's own printing, rounded
# to the minute. An end earlier than its start wraps to the next day. The almanac
# usually dates a window by the calendar day its start falls in; a handful of
# windows lying entirely between midnight and sunrise are instead dated by
# their HINDU day, so their printed times fall on the next civil date (their
# start anchors to a nakshatra boundary there, not on the printed date).
# The parity test consumes only the M/D column; weekday and times are context.
# Note: the 3/2 and 3/3 windows lie on the SAME Hindu day (Sunday Mar 2):
# a morning Sun+U.Bhadrapada span and a pre-dawn Sun+Ashwini tail ending at
# the Mar 3 sunrise. The test's sharedDay annotation accounts for it.
